benchmark_native_labels.purpose: Test capacity of agent to reason about shortest flight option. Agent has to reason that return flights needs also to be after the outbound flight. Also not all flights have economy option. Agent also has to reason about payment amounts.
benchmark_native_labels.reason_for_call:
You want to change the return flights for your upcoming Houston to Denver trip.
You want to change it to the fastest return trip (including stopover time) possible on the same day as the departure trip (May 27). If the fastest is not available, you are ok with the next fastest.
